headline: Clinton order directs federal agencies to carry out the United States' duties under international human rights treaties it has joined.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with how the federal government puts into practice the human rights treaties the United States has agreed to. It directs executive branch agencies to carry out the country's obligations under those treaties. No official summary was provided, so the exact steps the order requires are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to carry out the United States' obligations under human rights treaties it has joined.
